title: Claims Manual — Settling a RentGuard Renters Policy Contents Claim
content:
## Coverage of the occurrence

- A claim is opened on a RentGuard Renters Policy for each reported occurrence. The date of loss falls within a term during which the policy was in force.
- Property at a residence the insured moved from is covered only during the tier's moving-coverage period after the move-in date.

## Deductible

One deductible applies per occurrence and is absorbed by personal property first. Loss of use carries no deductible.

## Limits and exclusions applied to the loss

- Property away from the rental residence is covered up to the tier's off-premises percentage of Coverage C.
- Jewelry theft, portable electronics, bicycles, money and the landlord's furnishings are capped at the tier's special limits.
- Water backup is paid only up to the tier's water backup limit, and is denied with the reason *no water backup coverage* where that limit is 0.
- Flood and surface water are denied with the reason *surface water*.

## Payment of contents

| Tier settlement basis | Replacement-cost value of the property class | Payment | Amount | Depreciation withheld |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Actual cash value | any | actual cash value, final | replacement cost less depreciation less the deductible absorbed | none |
| Replacement cost | at or below the tier's no-withholding figure | replacement cost, full | replacement cost less the deductible absorbed | none |
| Replacement cost | above the tier's no-withholding figure | actual cash value, initial | replacement cost less depreciation less the deductible absorbed | the depreciation, in one holdback entry |

## Denial and closing

- A coverage part whose replacement-cost value does not exceed the deductible left for it is denied with the reason *below deductible*.
- A claim is closed once every part is paid or denied and no holdback remains.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical claims, deductible 500)

- **Actual cash value tier.** Electronics with a replacement-cost value of 1800.00 and depreciation of 600.00: payment 1800.00 less 600.00 less 500.00, which is 700.00, final; nothing withheld.
- **Replacement cost tier, no-withholding figure 1000.** A clothing class with a replacement-cost value of 900.00 absorbing the whole 500.00 deductible is paid 400.00 as full replacement cost.
- **Replacement cost tier, larger loss.** A furniture class with a replacement-cost value of 3000.00, depreciation 900.00, deductible 500.00: first payment 1600.00 as actual cash value, initial, and 900.00 withheld.
- **Below the deductible.** A part with a replacement-cost value of 450.00 facing the whole 500.00 deductible is denied, below deductible.
